description: Parking Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités is a dataset listed in GPSO - Grand Paris Seine Ouest - OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description: Couche géographique décrivant les Parkings Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités. Définition Les Parkings Vélos Île-de-France Mobilités sont un service de stationnement de vélos offrant des abris en libre-service et des consignes collectives sécurisées à proximité des gares et stations franciliennes. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine Ouest. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Vélo, Stationnement. Its keywords are Vélo, Stationnement, Données géographiques, Plateforme numérique, Collectivité, Parking Vélos. The portal shows 864 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seineouest-fr-portal.
